# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and System Information

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "Visual Studio Code" on the left side.
- **System Information Bar**: Located at the top center, shows the date and time "Oct 23 02:16".
- **System Notification Icon**: A bell icon is visible next to the date and time.
- **Window Control Buttons**: On the top right, there are three standard window control buttons: minimize (dash), maximize (square), and close (X).
- **Desktop Environment Indicator**: The "Activities" button is visible on the far left of the title bar, indicating the GNOME desktop environment.

## Application Menu Bar

- **Menu Items**: A horizontal menu bar with the following items from left to right:
  - File
  - Edit
  - Selection
  - View
  - Go
  - Run
  - Terminal
  - Help

## Left Sidebar (Activity Bar)

- **Application Icons**: A vertical column of icons on the far left side of the window.
  - **Chrome Browser Icon**: Topmost icon.
  - **Email Client Icon**: Second icon.
  - **Visual Studio Code Icon**: Third icon, representing the current application.
  - **Media Player Icon**: Fourth icon.
  - **Document Editor Icon**: Fifth icon.
  - **Spreadsheet Application Icon**: Sixth icon.
  - **Presentation Software Icon**: Seventh icon.
  - **Graphics Editor Icon**: Eighth icon.
  - **File Manager Icon**: Ninth icon.
  - **Software Center Icon**: Tenth icon.
  - **Help Icon**: Eleventh icon.
  - **Recycle Bin Icon**: Twelfth icon.
- **Bottom Section of Sidebar**:
  - **User Profile Icon**: A circular icon with a person silhouette.
  - **Settings Gear Icon**: A gear icon with a notification badge showing the number "1".
  - **Outline and Timeline Sections**: Two expandable sections labeled "OUTLINE" and "TIMELINE".

## Explorer Panel

- **Panel Title**: "EXPLORER" is displayed at the top of the panel.
- **Project Folder**: A folder named "PROJECT" is expanded, showing its contents.
  - **Files Inside Project Folder**:
    - `README.md`
    - `test_text_search.py`
    - `text_search.py`
- **Panel Controls**: Three dots (ellipsis) are visible to the right of the "EXPLORER" title, indicating additional options.

## Main Content Area

- **Welcome Tab**: The tab labeled "Welcome" is active, with a close button (X) next to it.
- **Welcome Page Content**:
  - **Main Heading**: "Visual Studio Code" in large font.
  - **Subheading**: "Editing evolved" in smaller font.
  - **Start Section**: Contains a list of actions:
    - New File...
    - Open File...
    - Open Folder
    - Connect to...
  - **Recent Section**: Displays "You have no recent files" as a message.
  - **Walkthroughs Section**: Contains a list of tutorials:
    - "Getting Started with VS Code" with a progress bar indicating completion.
    - "The Fundamentals" with a progress bar indicating partial completion.
- **Trust Dialog Box**:
  - **Title**: "Do you trust the authors of the files in this folder?"
  - **Icon**: A blue shield icon with a keyhole.
  - **Description Text**: Explains that VS Code provides features that may automatically execute files in the folder. It recommends restricted mode if trust is not established and provides a link to "our docs" for more information.
  - **Location Information**: Shows "~/project" as the folder path.
  - **Checkbox**: "Trust the authors of all files in the parent folder 'user'" with an unchecked box.
  - **Action Buttons**:
    - "No, I don't trust the authors" (gray button) with the text "Browse folder in restricted mode" below it.
    - "Yes, I trust the authors" (blue button) with the text "Trust folder and enable all features" below it.
- **Startup Setting**:
  - A checkbox labeled "Show welcome page on startup" is checked.

## Status Bar

- **Location**: At the bottom of the window.
- **Status Indicators**: Three icons with the number "0" next to each, indicating zero errors, warnings, and other statuses.
- **Additional Icon**: A small icon on the far right of the status bar.
